name: Kling AI China Plugin
tagline: Official Kling MCP with 4K video and optional HDR where available
description: Official Kling AI China remote MCP with browser OAuth. Kling 4.0 supports native 4K video and optional 10-bit HDR at 1080p or 4K when available in live MCP tools; HDR uses additional China account credits. Generate images and videos, manage Elements, use motion control, and track tasks. China and Global accounts, credits, and tasks are separate. Official npm Plugin: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/plugin-cn ; CLI: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/cli-cn . Setup: https://klingai.com/app/mcp/guide . Live OAuth MCP tool discovery exposes Kling Image 4.0 for text-to-image and reference-image editing, including single-image and related-image series generation.

install.notes: Authenticate with a Kling China account. Image or video generation consumes that account's credits. Kling 4.0 HDR may incur additional usage charges and requires live account/tool support.
